3 Iterative Planning with Natural Language
In this section, we provide an abstract description of iterative planning with
conversation. We define a generic framework for iterative planning with expla-
nations, focusing on user interaction points.
In our framework, users refine their preferences through iterative steps (Def-
inition 3). Each step is associated with a solution plan if it exists. In a step, the
user can ask questions (5) to refine or modify the current plan. As seen earlier,
questionshavebothatypeandatopic.Intherestofthispaper,wewillconsider
